raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# PR type

- [ ] Bug Fix
- [x] New Feature
- [x] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Expose Megatron Core's native training MLP chunking through `--mlp_chunks_for_training`, with a default of `1` that preserves existing behavior. Dense-model training can set a larger value on Core >=0.18 without passing the field through raw `megatron_extra_kwargs`. This integrates [NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#3656](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/3656) into the Megatron training path.

Validate the effective configuration after extra-kwargs overrides in both bridge backends. Reject invalid counts, unsupported older configurations, MoE, and selective MLP recomputation (which bypasses the upstream chunk branch). Keep the default, including an explicit raw override of `1`, compatible with older Core configurations. The global dependency minimum is unchanged.

Include Chinese/English parameter documentation, a dense BF16 full-parameter SFT example, and configuration/bridge regression tests.

## Experiment results

- `pre-commit run --all-files`: passed.
- Targeted tests: Core 0.18: **11 passed, 1 version-specific skip, 26 subtests passed**; Core 0.16: **7 passed, 5 version-specific skips, 24 subtests passed**. Test files: `tests/megatron/test_mlp_chunking.py`, `tests/megatron/test_megatron_model_utils.py`.
- Real Qwen3-0.6B-base BF16 full-parameter SFT on one H800, Core 0.18 / mcore-bridge 1.6.3 / PyTorch 2.10 / TE 2.11: chunks 1/2/4 each completed 6 optimizer steps at 2048 tokens; chunks 1/4 each completed 2 steps at 257 tokens. All runs saved checkpoints. First-layer hooks observed `[2048]`, `[1024, 1024]`, `[512, 512, 512, 512]`, and the nondivisible split `[65, 65, 65, 62]`.
- With identical seeds, inputs, and initial weights, the largest BF16 loss difference was 2.02e-4. First-layer post-clipping gradients differed by 1.17%–2.23% in relative L2; one-step updated weights differed by at most 3.06e-5 absolute. These short synthetic-data runs are execution and numerical checks, not convergence evidence.
- An additional upstream FP32 single-layer control at lengths 256/257 and chunks 1/2/4 passed output, parameter-gradient, and SGD-update comparisons with `atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5`; maximum errors were 2.39e-7, 4.71e-9, and 3.73e-9 respectively.

For the 2048-token run, steps 3–6 (after two warmup steps), micro/global batch 1:

| Chunks | Median step time | Input tokens/s | Peak allocated GiB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 0.14513 s | 14,111.7 | 16.11150 |
| 2 | 0.16769 s | 12,213.0 | 16.11150 |
| 4 | 0.19831 s | 10,327.3 | 16.19060 |

This workload showed no steady-state memory reduction and lower throughput with chunking; the documentation makes no universal memory-saving or speedup claim. GPU validation covered the default mcore-bridge path with selective `core_attn` recomputation. The megatron-bridge path has a provider-mock configuration regression test; distributed parallelism, other precisions, LoRA, and RLHF were not validated.

+- mlp_chunks_for_training: 训练时沿序列维度对 MLP 输入分块计算的块数，必须为正整数，默认为1（不分块）。大于1时需要 `megatron-core>=0.18`，目前仅支持 Dense 模型。实际块数受当前序列长度限制。
+  - 与 `--recompute_granularity selective --recompute_modules mlp` 不兼容，因为 MLP 重计算会绕过分块；默认的 `--recompute_modules core_attn` 可以使用。
+  - 分块可能降低单次 MLP 计算的临时显存开销，也可能降低吞吐；不保证保存的激活总量按块数等比例下降。请对比实际训练的显存峰值和吞吐。BF16 全参数 SFT 示例见[这里](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/megatron/dense/chunked_mlp.sh)。
 - 🔥train_iters: 训练的总迭代次数，默认为None。
   - 提示：你可以通过设置`--num_train_epochs`来设置训练的epochs数。在使用非流式数据集时，会自动根据数据集数量计算`train_iters`（兼容packing）。
 - 🔥num_train_epochs: 指定训练的epochs数。当使用非流式数据集时，该参数会为你自动计算train_iters而不需要手动传入`train_iters`。当使用流式数据集时，该参数会在训练到`num_train_epochs`时强制退出训练，并对权重进行验证和保存。默认为None。

@@ -19,6 +19,9 @@
   - "layernorm": Recomputes the input_layernorm and pre_mlp_layernorm.
   - "mla_up_proj": Recomputes the MLA up-projection and RoPE application parts.
 - deterministic_mode: Deterministic mode, which may lead to slower training speed, default is False.
+- mlp_chunks_for_training: Number of chunks used to compute the MLP along the sequence dimension during training. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 1 (no chunking). Values greater than 1 require `megatron-core>=0.18` and are currently supported only for dense models. The actual number of chunks is limited by the current sequence length.
+  - Incompatible with `--recompute_granularity selective --recompute_modules mlp`, since MLP recomputation bypasses chunking. The default `--recompute_modules core_attn` is compatible.
+  - Chunking may reduce temporary memory used by each MLP call, but may also reduce throughput. It does not guarantee a proportional reduction in total saved activations. Compare peak memory and throughput on your workload. See the [BF16 full-parameter SFT example](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/megatron/dense/chunked_mlp.sh).
 - 🔥train_iters: Total number of training iterations, default is None.
   - Tip: You can set `--num_train_epochs` to specify the number of training epochs. When using a non-streaming dataset, `train_iters` will be automatically calculated based on the dataset size (compatible with packing).
 - 🔥num_train_epochs: Specifies the number of training epochs. When using non-streaming datasets, this parameter will automatically calculate train_iters for you without the need to manually pass `train_iters`. When using streaming datasets, this parameter will force exit the training when `num_train_epochs` is reached, and perform validation and saving of weights. Defaults to None.

+def _check_mlp_chunks_for_training(args, config, overrides):

+    chunks = overrides.get('mlp_chunks_for_training', getattr(args, 'mlp_chunks_for_training', 1))

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+import unittest
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+_IMPORT_ERROR = ''
+try:
+    import torch
+    from mcore_bridge.model import get_mcore_model_type, get_model_meta
+    from transformers import Qwen3Config
+
+    from swift.megatron.model import utils
+except ImportError as e:
+    utils = None
+    _IMPORT_ERROR = str(e)
+
+_HAS_CHUNKING = utils is not None and hasattr(utils.ModelConfig, 'mlp_chunks_for_training')
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _LegacyConfig:
+    """Model configurations before MCore 0.18 have no training chunk field."""
+    num_moe_experts: int = None
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(utils is not None, f'Megatron dependencies not available: {_IMPORT_ERROR}')
+class TestMLPChunking(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.hf_config = Qwen3Config(
+            num_hidden_layers=2,
+            hidden_size=64,
+            intermediate_size=128,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            num_key_value_heads=2,
+            head_dim=16,
+            vocab_size=128)
+        self.args = SimpleNamespace(
+            megatron_model_meta=get_model_meta(get_mcore_model_type(self.hf_config.model_type)),
+            task_type='causal_lm',
+            torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            decoder_first_pipeline_num_layers=None,
+            decoder_last_pipeline_num_layers=None,
+            fp4_param_gather=False,
+            fp8_param_gather=False,
+            router_replay_mode='disabled',
+            padding_free=True,
+            mlp_chunks_for_training=1,
+            recompute_granularity='selective',
+            recompute_modules=['core_attn'],
+            megatron_extra_kwargs=None)
+        # Weight conversion needs distributed groups; configuration validation does not.
+        bridge_patch = patch.object(self.args.megatron_model_meta, 'bridge_cls', return_value=None)
+        bridge_patch.start()
+        self.addCleanup(bridge_patch.stop)
+
+    def test_disabled_chunking_preserves_default_config(self):
+        for extra_kwargs in (None, {'mlp_chunks_for_training': 1}):
+            with self.subTest(extra_kwargs=extra_kwargs):
+                self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs = extra_kwargs
+                config = utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+                self.assertEqual(getattr(config, 'mlp_chunks_for_training', 1), 1)
+
+    @unittest.skipIf(_HAS_CHUNKING, 'Requires a configuration predating megatron-core 0.18')
+    def test_older_mcore_rejects_enabled_chunking(self):
+        for chunks, extra_kwargs in ((2, None), (1, {'mlp_chunks_for_training': 4})):
+            with self.subTest(chunks=chunks, extra_kwargs=extra_kwargs):
+                self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = chunks
+                self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs = extra_kwargs
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'megatron-core>=0.18'):
+                    utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_CHUNKING, 'Requires megatron-core>=0.18')
+    def test_chunk_count_reaches_model_config(self):
+        for chunks in (2, 4):
+            with self.subTest(chunks=chunks):
+                self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = chunks
+                config = utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+                self.assertEqual(config.mlp_chunks_for_training, chunks)
+                self.assertEqual(config.recompute_modules, ['core_attn'])
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_CHUNKING, 'Requires megatron-core>=0.18')
+    def test_extra_kwargs_override_cli_chunk_count(self):
+        self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 4
+        for chunks in (1, 2):
+            with self.subTest(chunks=chunks):
+                self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs = {'mlp_chunks_for_training': chunks}
+                config = utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+                self.assertEqual(config.mlp_chunks_for_training, chunks)
+
+    def test_invalid_counts_are_rejected_in_both_inputs(self):
+        for chunks in (0, -1, 1.5, True, None):
+            for use_extra_kwargs in (False, True):
+                with self.subTest(chunks=chunks, use_extra_kwargs=use_extra_kwargs):
+                    self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 1 if use_extra_kwargs else chunks
+                    self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs = {'mlp_chunks_for_training': chunks} if use_extra_kwargs else None
+                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'positive integer'):
+                        utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_CHUNKING, 'Requires megatron-core>=0.18')
+    def test_selective_mlp_recomputation_checks_effective_overrides(self):
+        self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 4
+        self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs = {'recompute_modules': ['core_attn', 'mlp']}
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'bypasses chunking'):
+            utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+
+        self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs['mlp_chunks_for_training'] = 1
+        config = utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+        self.assertIn('mlp', config.recompute_modules)
+        self.assertEqual(config.mlp_chunks_for_training, 1)
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_CHUNKING, 'Requires megatron-core>=0.18')
+    def test_full_recomputation_is_allowed(self):
+        self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 4
+        self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs = {
+            'recompute_granularity': 'full',
+            'recompute_method': 'uniform',
+            'recompute_num_layers': 1,
+        }
+        config = utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+        self.assertEqual(config.recompute_granularity, 'full')
+        self.assertEqual(config.mlp_chunks_for_training, 4)
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_CHUNKING, 'Requires megatron-core>=0.18')
+    def test_moe_is_rejected_before_model_construction(self):
+        self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 4
+        self.args.megatron_extra_kwargs = {'num_moe_experts': 4}
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'dense models'):
+            utils.get_mcore_model_config(self.args, self.hf_config)
+
+    def test_legacy_configs_keep_default_and_reject_enabled_chunking(self):
+        for config in (_LegacyConfig, _LegacyConfig()):
+            for overrides in ({}, {'mlp_chunks_for_training': 1}):
+                with self.subTest(config=config, overrides=overrides):
+                    self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 1
+                    utils._check_mlp_chunks_for_training(self.args, config, overrides)
+                    self.assertNotIn('mlp_chunks_for_training', overrides)
+                    _LegacyConfig(**overrides)
+            self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 4
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'megatron-core>=0.18'):
+                utils._check_mlp_chunks_for_training(self.args, config, {})
+            self.args.mlp_chunks_for_training = 1
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'megatron-core>=0.18'):
+                utils._check_mlp_chunks_for_training(self.args, config, {'mlp_chunks_for_training': 4})
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
